About

I'm a Data Engineer who designs and runs the pipelines that turn scattered source data into datasets people can actually query and trust.

My day-to-day lives in Azure Data Factory and Databricks — building medallion-architecture pipelines (Bronze → Silver → Gold) on Delta Lake with Unity Catalog, tuning PySpark jobs for scale, and layering in semantic search with Azure OpenAI embeddings so teams can query product data in plain language.

Outside of pipeline work, I completed the McKinsey Forward Program, sharpening how I structure problems and communicate with stakeholders — skills I bring back into how I scope and explain engineering decisions.
